A laddered maturity structure will ensure that the portfolio remains diversified and is not heavily exposed to any single year's maturities. Additionally, I suggest maintaining the focus on investment-grade corporate bonds but considering the allocation of 10% to high-yield bonds (BB-rated) to take advantage of higher yields without increasing the overall portfolio duration excessively.
